newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Gulf Canada up in N.Y. trade.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Gulf Canada up in N.Y. trade.

text.p: Gulf Canada Resources Ltd highlighted trade in foreign stocks on Thursday with news of a $158 million share issue.
Gulf Canada was up 3/8 to 8-1/4. Volume was heavy and the stock was among the most active on the New York Stock Exchange.
The company said it would offer 20 million shares at $7.875 apiece and the offer would close on Jan 15. The money would go to help fund the takeover of Britain's Clyde Petroleum Plc.

Among American Depositary Receipts (ADRs), Nordic telecoms Nokia and AB LM Ericsson were up, boosted by a rise in Motorola Inc. Nokia was up 2-1/2 to 63 on heavy volume and Ericsson rose 1-1/16 to 32-5/8.
Bermuda insurer Exel Ltd eased 1/8 to 37-3/8 on heavy volume after it reported a rise in fourth quarter earnings per share.
Advancers led decliners by 270 to 226 among 807 ADRs. Volume was 55.5 million shares at midday.
